name: COVID-19 Vaccination Coverage, ZIP Code
rowLabel: COVID-19 coverage metric for a subpopulation in a ZIP Code by week

Metadata.Time Period: September 13, 2023 through the most recent date shown

columns.name: ZIP Code
columns.description: Home ZIP Code of the person vaccinated.

columns.name: Week End
columns.description: End date of the week. Dates are based on standard MMWR weeks as defined by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

columns.name: Season
columns.description: Annually recurring reporting period for which estimates are calculated.

columns.name: Age Group
columns.description: Values used are: 0-17, 18-64, 65+, 18+, Unknown, All Ages

columns.name: Population Size
columns.description: Number of people in the group based on the specified combination of ZIP Code and age.

columns.name: Count
columns.description: Number of people in the specified group that achieved the vaccination status.

columns.name: Percent
columns.description: Percent of people in the specified group that achieved the vaccination status.

columns.name: ZIP Code Centroid
columns.description: A point that falls inside the ZIP Code, usually the centroid but adjusted if the centroid would fall outside the Zip. It is present to facilitate geographic analysis.

columns.name: MMWR Week
columns.description: A weekly counting system within a calendar year standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

columns.name: Week
columns.description: The calendar week standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

columns.name: Current Season Week End
columns.description: Ending date of the MMWR week for the current season

columns.name: Census Tracts
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Census Tracts' (bdys-3d7i) the point in column 'zip_code_centroid' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
